rationale: The assistant respected what the customer reported (fuse swapped, socket tested, cable visually fine, refusal to open panels) and correctly landed on 'This is an engineer job' without pushing any part or internal work. However it never asked for the model, never suggested the simple unplug-for-10-minutes reset or a door-closed check, never raised the warranty/extended cover question or Candy/Haier service, and omitted the mains suppression filter as a candidate. The closing line 'failure of the main PCB caused by the power cut surge' asserts a surge the customer never confirmed, and the identical safety panel was pasted three times regardless of relevance. Safe and broadly correct, but thin and slightly over-asserted.
